title: Team Leader
description:
**Company Description**
UniCompare is a forward-thinking EdTech company focused on transforming higher education by connecting universities with the evolving needs of students. The organization builds a world-class learning ecosystem that supports growth, innovation, and accessibility for learners from diverse backgrounds. Through close collaboration with leading universities and educational institutions, UniCompare develops technology-driven solutions that enhance teaching and learning experiences. By combining digital tools, curated resources, and academic expertise, UniCompare helps students gain the skills and competencies needed to thrive in the digital era.
  
**Role Description**
The Team Leader role at UniCompare is a full-time, on-site position based in Sadar. The Team Leader will oversee a small cross-functional team, coordinate daily activities, and ensure that performance goals and project milestones are met. Key responsibilities include assigning tasks, monitoring progress, providing guidance and support, and facilitating effective communication within the team and with other departments. The role involves tracking operational metrics, identifying process improvements, and contributing to the delivery of high-quality services and solutions for partner institutions and students. The Team Leader will also support team development through coaching, feedback, and collaboration in a fast-paced EdTech environment.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Leadership and team management skills, including experience overseeing small teams and coordinating daily workflows.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with colleagues, partners, and stakeholders.
* Organizational and time management abilities to handle multiple tasks, prioritize work, and meet deadlines.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills to interpret data, identify issues, and suggest practical improvements.
* Comfort with technology and digital tools, preferably within an EdTech or education-focused environment.
* Ability to work on-site in Sadar and engage with team members and stakeholders in person.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Business, Management, Education, or related discipline) or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in a supervisory, coordinator, or team lead role is highly beneficial.

title: Store Manager
description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.
   

  

**Overview**
 As the
 **Store Manager** 
 , you will lead a dedicated team of store associates \& leaders every day, to create an exceptional consumer experience. Your focus will be on driving sales, providing excellent customer service, maintaining visual presentations, and developing talent within the store. This role offers opportunity to grow and collaborate with industry leading teammates and partners.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
* Deliver outstanding service to our consumers using our C.H.A.R.M service model
* Leads the store team in surpassing performance metrics including sales, consumer service and charms
* Apply analytical thinking \& company reporting to find opportunities within store, empowering the team to make strategic decisions
* Lead visual presentation, product flow, replenishment, and operational standards throughout the store
* Build Foster a welcoming, inclusive environment that engages promotes internal growth and builds an external network of talent
* Coordinate, delegate, prioritize and meet store deadlines while ensuring effective follow up on daily activities
* Contribute to crafting a team environment that encourages sharing of suggestions, ideas, and concerns while upholding Crocs Inc. values
* Learn \& assist in various departments including consumer service, product knowledge, visual presentation, and stock room management.
* Support team members in the daily execution of retail operations i.e., POS system management and use, stock replenishment, assist in pricing and markdown processes seasonally, promote loyalty programs, maintain cleanliness and recovery standards etc.
* Adhere to Crocs, Inc. Asset Protection policies and procedures, including shortage prevention, inventory control, and compliance procedures


****What You'll Bring to the Table****
  

  

* Must be 18 years or older
+ 4\+ years of total retail experience, preferably with previous Store Manager experience.

* Proven leadership skills with the ability to challenge, empower, and drive team results
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) to successfully connect with store team members, operations managers, district managers and corporate partners
* Desire to succeed in a high growth, fast\-paced retail environment
* Flexibility in work schedule including availability for nights, weekends, holidays and extended hour s


 The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other protected classification.

title: Front Office Manager (m/w/d) - Studentjob.at
description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung
   

  

**Unser Herz schlägt türkis.**
 Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung großgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.
   

  

 Mit unserer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für modernes Design und hohe Servicequalität schaffen wir für unsere Gäste bei Motel One ein Zuhause für unterwegs. Unsere mehr als 104 Hotels in 14 Ländern überzeugen mit exklusivem Design, hohen Servicestandards und erstklassigen innerstädtischen Standorten zu einem attraktiven Preis.
   

  

 Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.
   

  

 Stellenbeschreibung
   

  

 Als Front Office Manager (m/w/d) sorgst du mit deinem Gespür für Menschen und deiner Präsenz am Empfang dafür, dass sich unsere Gäste vom ersten Moment an willkommen fühlen.
   

  

 Dabei führst du dein Team mit Empathie sowie Klarheit und schaffst ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld. Dein Anspruch: ein reibungsloser Ablauf am Front Office – von der Anreise bis zum Check\-out – und ein professioneller Auftritt, der Gäste nachhaltig begeistert.
   

  

 Darüber hinaus zählt zu deinen Aufgaben:
   

  

  

* Durchführung von Check\-Ins sowie Prüfung der Reservierungen, Überbuchungen und Optionen
* Überwachung der Kosten\- und des Logis\-Erlösbudgets
* Sicherstellung der Qualitätsstandards sowie Pflege des Qualitätsmanagementsystems
* Erstellung der Dienst\- und Urlaubspläne
* Einarbeitung, Motivation und Führung des Empfangsteams
* Durchführung von internen Coachings, Cross Trainings und Planung von Schulungen zur Weiterentwicklung der Front Office Mitarbeitenden
* Entwicklung der Auszubildenden
* enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Reservierung und Sales


 Qualifikationen
   

  

 Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung und bist ein Vorbild? Persönlichkeit und ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualitäten zeichnen dich aus? \- Du passt zu uns! Denn das steht bei uns an erster Stelle!
   

  

 Außerdem bringst du mit:
   

  

  

* Ausbildung im Hotelfach bzw. Mind. 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie / Gastronomie oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg (zum Beispiel mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung als Teamleitung im Servicebereich)
* Freude an der Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden und erste Führungserfahrung erforderlich
* Gastgeberqualitäten und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung
* Offenes, kommunikatives Auftreten, gute Umgangsformen sowie eine gute Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch \& Englisch (Wort \& Schrift)
* Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft abteilungsübergreifend zu unterstützen – Wir erreichen unsere Erfolge gemeinsam

title: Site Admin
description:
APM Terminals
   

  

 Lead end\-to\-end admin operations, ensuring day\-to\-day management of admin activities, team workflow coordination, provider onboarding, documentation compliance, and smooth operational execution. Assist in planning new initiatives and programmes while managing admin operations in line with applicable codes of practice and Maersk ethos. Utilize operational metrics and data analysis to enhance team efficiency, improve SLA compliance, and support effective decision\-making.
   

  

**Admin Asset \& Infrastructure Management:** 
 Organize the end\-to\-end admin asset lifecycle, including maintenance of admin assets and infrastructure, implementation of automated tracking systems, and reduction of Time\-to\-Repair/replacement.
   

  

**Performance Optimization:** 
 Utilized data analytics to identify skill gaps, design targeted training programmes, increase manpower productivity, ensure optimal deployment, and enable cost\-effective usage of materials, manpower and equipment. Drive Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) initiatives for admin assets: Usage optimization, cost benchmarking, AMC \& contract rationalization. Identify and execute cost\-saving projects (₹/move impact). Build MIS for: Maintenance cost trends and Cost per equipment.
   

  

**Policy Implementation \& Compliance:** 
 Standardized admin policy documentation and compliance procedures, maintained all required documents including logbooks, ensured adherence to SOPs, supported regulatory compliance, and implemented best practices across admin operations.
   

  

**Reporting \& Controls:** 
 Generated weekly metrics and statutory reports on admin operations, maintained systems for receipt and dispatch of goods, and ensured effective stock control of housekeeping, stationery, and other admin\-related items procured for the site.
   

  

**Vendor, Contract \& SLA Management:** 
 Optimized vendor contract negotiations, ensured timely contract renewals for admin services, maintained contracts, documents, warranty certificates and claims, enabled timely vendor payments, and ensured cab service SLA compliance while maintaining high\-quality operational support.
   

  

**Housekeeping, Safety \& Site Administration:** 
 Established and implemented effective housekeeping practices at site, ensured all admin\-related activities were performed as per safety norms, and supported overall site administration through structured processes and continuous monitoring.
   

  

**Education – Postgraduate, Preferred \- MBA**
**Certification \& Skills** 
 – Proficient in MS Office, Knowledge of SAP/IFS or similar ERP systems. Knowledge/ Hands on experience on Data Analysis, AI, Power BI, Autocad, MS Projects will be an advantage.
